title: Connect apps
subOwner: For each app, you choose which agents use it. Anything that publishes, spends or messages a customer is handed to you, whatever the app.

ownIntro: Add any tool that speaks MCP, by its address or as a command that runs in the work sandbox. The agent gets every tool it lists.
name: Name
nameHint: A name for it, like my-crm
addressHint: https://… or an http:// address on your own network
kindCommand: A command in the work sandbox
commandHint: The program to run, like node or od
argsHint: One per line, each exactly as you type it.
commandNote: It runs in the company’s work sandbox, starting in the agent’s own folder, never in the engine. Anyone who talks to the company’s agents can see what it does there.
tokenHint: Pasted once and kept only by the engine.
tokenNote: gtmworks never stores or shows this token.
addedAlready: This server is already added for this agent.
removeAsk: Remove {0}? Every agent that has it loses it.
ownInvalid: Use a name of letters, numbers and hyphens, and an http or https address.
ownCollision: That name belongs to an app gtmworks already offers. Pick another.
envRequired: Fill every field the app needs to connect.
careCustomers: Every Member who talks to an Agent with this app on reaches its customer records.
careMoney: Every Member who talks to an Agent with this app on reaches its money and can spend through it.
tokenNeeded: Paste the token this server needs.
ownAttention: {0} was added, but it did not answer. Check the address and token.
error.appsServerInvalid: That name, address or command can’t be used.
connectAttention: It was added, but the engine did not reach it. Check the address or the token, or sign in again.
